basic_details.job_title: BPBCC Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 18 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Diploma in Civil Engineering through Non-Distance Mode (Regular Course) from an AICTE-recognised institution, or an equivalent course declared by AICTE, or a regular-mode Diploma in Civil Engineering from a University or Deemed University established under the UGC Act; plus minimum 02 years of building construction experience on an equivalent post.
qualification.details: Qualification: Diploma in Civil Engineering issued through Non-Distance Mode (Regular Course) by an institution recognised by AICTE, New Delhi, or an equivalent qualification (course declared equivalent to the diploma under the schedule 'Major Disciplines, their corresponding Courses and Relevant/Appropriate Branch of Diploma in Engineering and Technology' of the AICTE Approval Process Hand Book); OR Diploma in Civil Engineering issued through Non-Distance Mode (Regular Course) by a University or Deemed University established under the provisions of the UGC Act, or an equivalent diploma awarded by a University or Deemed University in Non-Distance Mode Experience: Minimum 02 years of work experience on an equivalent post in building construction work in a government undertaking / public undertaking / reputed private institution; experience certificate must carry the company's CIN/GSTIN. Age limit: 21 to 37 years (as on 1 November 2026) Age relaxation: BC, EBC, BC Women, UR Women Maximum 40 years, SC and ST (Male and Female) Maximum 42 years | Other conditions: | Reservation benefit only for native residents of Bihar Diploma must be through Non-Distance Mode (Regular Course) | Desirable: | Experience in preparing estimates as per map/SOR Experience and knowledge of getting quality work done as per approved map Understanding and knowledge of quality of construction materials

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from https://bpbcc.bihar.gov.in/.
Fill in the form and paste a self-attested recent photograph.
Attach legible self-attested copies of certificates and 2 extra photographs.
Send it by post or hand it in at the office of the Director General of Police-cum-Chairman-cum-Managing Director, Bihar Police Building Construction Corporation, Kautilya Nagar, Patna-14, Bihar.
Application must be received by 25-11-2026, 5:30 PM; applications by email will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: BPBCC Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. HQ 3783 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download BPBCC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Diploma in Civil Engineering issued through Non-Distance Mode (Regular Course) by an institution recognised by AICTE, New Delhi, or an equivalent qualification (course declared equivalent to the diploma under the schedule 'Major Disciplines, their corresponding Courses and Relevant/Appropriate Branch of Diploma in Engineering and Technology' of the AICTE Approval Process Hand Book); OR Diploma in Civil Engineering issued through Non-Distance Mode (Regular Course) by a University or Deemed University established under the provisions of the UGC Act, or an equivalent diploma awarded by a University or Deemed University in Non-Distance Mode Experience: Minimum 02 years of work experience on an equivalent post in building construction work in a government undertaking / public undertaking / reputed private institution; experience certificate must carry the company's CIN/GSTIN. Age limit: 21 to 37 years (as on 1 November 2026) Age relaxation: BC, EBC, BC Women, UR Women Maximum 40 years, SC and ST (Male and Female) Maximum 42 years Other conditions: Reservation benefit only for native residents of Bihar Diploma must be through Non-Distance Mode (Regular Course) Desirable: Experience in preparing estimates as per map/SOR Experience and knowledge of getting quality work done as per approved map Understanding and knowledge of quality of construction materials

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for BPBCC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates with a vigilance case, departmental proceedings or serious charges pending, a penalty imposed or a criminal case registered will not be engaged Applications received by email will not be considered

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Engagement for one year; may be extended or reduced on the basis of efficiency and performance as required Contract staff will not be treated as government servants and are not entitled to government servants' facilities No claim to regularisation; the engagement is temporary Engagement ends automatically if not extended before the contract expires; no order needed

content_sections.heading: How Will BPBCC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting Interview by a selection committee constituted by the Corporation Selection by a selection committee constituted by the Corporation Shortlisted candidates informed of the interview by email / on the Corporation website Original certificates to be brought at the interview No travelling allowance for the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Educational certificates (10th, 12th and Diploma) with marksheets Caste certificate, residence certificate and EWS certificate Date of birth certificate Experience certificate with company's CIN/GSTIN Other necessary certificates and documents (self-attested copies) 2 extra photographs

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BPBCC Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from https://bpbcc.bihar.gov.in/. Fill in the form and paste a self-attested recent photograph. Attach legible self-attested copies of certificates and 2 extra photographs. Send it by post or hand it in at the office of the Director General of Police-cum-Chairman-cum-Managing Director, Bihar Police Building Construction Corporation, Kautilya Nagar, Patna-14, Bihar. Application must be received by 25-11-2026, 5:30 PM; applications by email will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: BPBCC Junior Engineer (Civil) Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BPBCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BPBCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 18 vacancies for Junior Engineer (Civil).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for BPBCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed form downloadable from https://bpbcc.bihar.gov.in/ (form on pages 2-3 of this PDF)) and send it to Office of the Director General of Police-cum-Chairman-cum-Managing Director, Bihar Police Building Construction Corporation, Kautilya Nagar, Patna-14, Bihar, by by post or in person, to reach by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 37 years (as on 1 November 2026). Relaxation: BC, EBC, BC Women, UR Women Maximum 40 years, SC and ST (Male and Female) Maximum 42 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Diploma in Civil Engineering through Non-Distance Mode (Regular Course) from an AICTE-recognised institution, or an equivalent course declared by AICTE, or a regular-mode Diploma in Civil Engineering from a University or Deemed University established under the UGC Act; plus minimum 02 years of building construction experience on an equivalent post.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Reservation benefit only for native residents of Bihar. Diploma must be through Non-Distance Mode (Regular Course).

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with a vigilance case, departmental proceedings or serious charges pending, a penalty imposed or a criminal case registered will not be engaged. Applications received by email will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting. Interview by a selection committee constituted by the Corporation. Selection by a selection committee constituted by the Corporation. Shortlisted candidates informed of the interview by email / on the Corporation website.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement for one year; may be extended or reduced on the basis of efficiency and performance as required. Contract staff will not be treated as government servants and are not entitled to government servants' facilities. No claim to regularisation; the engagement is temporary.
